fullSelectedCorpusOverlap.definition: casefolded character trigrams with whitespace removed; full selected corpus only
fullSelectedCorpusOverlap.limitation: No inference about training contamination, independence or annotation correctness.

phase1.limitation: Maven logs include component mocks. They are not production-load or real-database concurrency evidence. Initial stale-JNI failure remains archived.

issues.detail: Repeated question texts, including contradictory gold sets, invalidate treating all 300 rows as independent observations.
benchmark_builder.py assigns public grades by evidence position (3,2,1), not source relevance judgments.
candidate10 content comprises identifier/pressure fixtures; family membership is not a software dependency or incident label.
Frozen qrels have a header and three fields; standard TREC requires query, iteration, document, relevance. No labels were changed.
Original builder screens 180 public questions against corpus.json and candidate10 only; enterprise rows have no leakage_score; selected Hotpot/split passages were outside that screen.

QuadPath ID invokes BM25, 128-bucket hashed vectors and metadata-family scores, followed by RRF and tie breaking. No fourth metadata ranking, Qwen embedding, graph traversal or backend call is executed.
eval_runner_300.py loops over queries and methods synchronously; stage elapsed times do not measure production concurrency.
K=1,3,5,10 cutoff analysis does not implement alpha/h/chunk-size/RRF grids.
No incident, annotation, metered-energy or finance records establish MTTR, hallucination, kappa, 312% ROI, or cost superiority.
